quarterly_data.quarter: Victory Giant Technology investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: Huizhou Plant 4 is in a steady ramp-up and release phase, with its revenue contribution depending on customers' product iterations and volume timing, product mix and delivery / revenue recognition; orders on hand are full and capacity utilization is at a good level; order visibility is high, production is scheduled against customer orders, and its capacity expansions are all backed by firm orders and demand. Plants 10 and 11 are not yet connected and in production; trial production will follow, and they are planned mainly for high-end compute-server products. Several high-end products in AI compute, data centers, high-performance computing and optical modules are in large-scale mass production, and R&D iteration products co-developed with core customers are progressing smoothly; 'mass production' means products that have passed customer validation and entered volume production and delivery.
